services.name: QMT Summer Camp
services.desc: Get ready to move it, move it. QMT Summer Camp gives young performers the chance to spend a full month rehearsing, learning, and creating-then step into the spotlight in a fully staged production of Madagascar Jr. on the Quincy Music Theatre

services.name: Clinic
services.desc: When middle-aged baseball fanatic Joe Boyd trades his soul to the Devil, also known as Mr. Applegate, for a chance to lead his favorite team to victory in the pennant race against the New York Yankees, he has no idea the trouble he’s getting into. As young baseball sensation, Joe Hardy, he transforms the hapless Washington Senators into a winning team, only to realize the true worth of the life that he’s left behind. Light, fast-paced and devilishly clever, Damn Yankees is a comedic firecracker, featuring an all-American story and an irreverent sense of humor. In-Person Audition Dates: Dec 15 OR 16 at 6:30 p.m.Virtual Audition Deadline: Dec 16 at 6:00 p.m. Callbacks: Dec 17 by director
